structure.unit: Enforcement, Collection, Refunds, Remedies and Review of Local Taxes

law.catch_line: Subsequent collection by treasurer of delinquent taxes on subjects other than real estate
law.text: After delinquent taxes appear in the lists required by § 58.1-3921, the governing body may require the treasurer to continue to collect the delinquent taxes on subjects other than real estate until the expiration of the applicable statute of limitations.
